channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Intent-based swaps cut sandwich risk; approvals still matter
item.description: Is cowswap safer than Uniswap? For routine swaps, it usually lowers sandwich risk through batch auctions; approvals, phishing and fake tokens remain your responsibility.

item.title: EU proposes crypto crackdown in 22nd Russia sanctions package
item.description: The European Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions package would extend transaction bans to 60 banks and target crypto networks, including third-country enablers.

item.title: How to refinance a DeFi loan without a liquidation
item.description: To refinance a DeFi loan to a lower interest rate, compare rates at your debt size, move collateral in chunks or one transaction, then confirm the old loan is closed.

item.title: Can I safely swap an airdropped ERC-20 token on a DEX?
item.description: You can sometimes swap airdropped tokens safely on a DEX, but verify the token contract and wallet prompt first; an unsolicited deposit is no proof of legitimacy.

item.title: Move on Sui: How Its Rules Protect Coins
item.description: What is the Move language on Sui? Move is a resource-safe smart-contract language; Sui Move organizes assets as objects with explicit ownership.

item.title: Does speeding up a pending Gnosis Bridge deposit change it?
item.description: Speeding up a pending bridge transaction keeps its token, amount and recipient unchanged; MetaMask raises the fee, and the mined replacement has a new hash.

item.title: Choose a DEX for a Swap That Clears Safely and Cheaply
item.description: What to check before choosing a DEX for a swap: compare network and token support, total cost after fees, MEV protection and slippage for the trade you plan to make.

item.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles team for AI and quantum security
item.description: The Ethereum Foundation doubled its protocol security team and put hash-based cryptography first, citing AI as a more urgent risk than quantum computing.

item.title: Token Address Checks: CoinGecko and Etherscan
item.description: To verify a token contract, use project docs for the starting address, CoinGecko to match its chain, and Etherscan to inspect the deployed contract.

item.title: How to switch RPC endpoint in MetaMask for a stuck transaction
item.description: To switch an RPC endpoint in MetaMask for a stuck transaction, choose a working endpoint for the same network, update its RPC URL, then check the hash before replacing anything.

item.title: Shiba Swap liquidity removal through SSLP burning
item.description: Remove liquidity from shiba swap by unstaking SSLP, selecting the pool and confirming removal; both tokens return to your wallet at the pool’s current ratio.

item.title: Bitcoin bridge: exchange or DeFi wallet?
item.description: Bitcoin holders new to DeFi can use an exchange for simple BTC trades, or bridge BTC into teleBTC on an EVM chain while keeping their own wallet keys.

item.title: Fluidkey Says SigNoz Flaws Led to $1.6 Million Theft
item.description: Fluidkey says two unpatched SigNoz flaws exposed session tokens used to steal about $1.6 million from 52 accounts, while personal data and viewing keys were accessed.

item.title: US Gets Court Authority to Seize $1.2B in Binance Hack Funds
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of $1.2 billion from Binance's $6 billion hack; tracing and forfeiture efforts continue.

item.title: World Bank to explore USDC rails with Citi and Circle
item.description: The World Bank Group will study USDC payment rails with Citi and Circle, exploring whether they can speed fund disbursements and improve tracking.

item.title: Ethereum Token Approval: Spender vs. Token Contract
item.description: To check the spender address on an Ethereum token approval, open the confirmed transaction and read approve(spender, amount); verify it against the app’s official details.

item.title: After buying a Solana token, choose the right tracker
item.description: DexScreener vs Birdeye for tracking a token after buying: use DexScreener for one pool and Birdeye to monitor several holdings in a wallet.

item.title: Bridge relayers earn user fees for completed deliveries
item.description: Who pays bridge relayers and why? Users fund each transfer fee, covering destination gas plus a margin so messages keep moving when gas rises.

item.title: A Gnosis Bridge Transfer Waits When Ethereum Confirms
item.description: A bridge transfer can stay pending after deposit confirmation because Ethereum inclusion starts the process; validators must relay the message and Gnosis Chain must execute it.

item.title: Pending bridge deposit: speed up or cancel?
item.description: Speed up or cancel a pending bridge deposit in MetaMask? Learn when to replace a transaction, cancel it, or wait for the bridge to finish.
